row.title: Dispatch judges list and gate triggers with the claims rule (US-08-R03)
row.body: runTick takes a triggerJudge; the composition root passes core/claims triggerState, so a ready item whose list or gate trigger is not done goes back to open with a trigger_guard outcome instead of being dispatched and worked once. Proven by node --test workers/core/test/tick.test.js.
